prompt:
Create a NEW finished character illustration for Kalistar x Final Fantasy VII: BARRET WALLACE FIRING HIS GUN-ARM DURING THE INFILTRATION OF A MAKO REACTOR. First reference is Barret's identity and clothes, second reference is the approved Kalistar painterly style and quality. Do NOT copy their poses or scenes. This is NOT the tender father-daughter scene and NOT a cannon raised into the sky.

A FURIOUS ACTION BEAT: inside the enormous green-lit machinery hall of a Mako reactor, Barret pushes forward on a grated metal catwalk and unleashes his rotary gun-arm at an offscreen Shinra threat. Feet planted wide, knees flexed, torso leaning into recoil. His face is a major focal point: eyes visible, brow clenched, blazing determination, teeth bared in a full-throated battle roar, rage with humanity, not a comic grimace. Sweat on temples, dog tags swinging, worn vest catching the recoil. Recognizable dark brown skin, muscular stocky body, short flat-top hair, rugged beard, scars, sunglasses pushed onto forehead, brown sleeveless leather vest, black shirt, olive cargo trousers, heavy boots. His human LEFT hand is clenched alongside his torso for balance, not holding a second weapon. His RIGHT forearm IS the gun, mounted naturally below his elbow. Exact recognizable Barret anatomy, one human left hand and one right gun prosthesis.

THE CANNON MUST LOOK REAL AND BE READABLE IN THE CARD: a robust forearm-sized mechanical receiver with clearly articulated steel barrel tubes, realistic restrained proportions and connections. No gigantic absurd tower and no tiny stump, no handle with a human hand, no floating barrels. Show it firing forward at chest height, with a moderate three-quarter side view that shows the barrels' LENGTH and the muzzle together, not directly down the barrel. Orient his torso and right arm coherently. Keep the COMPLETE weapon in the central safe area of the picture, muzzle approximately x=32%, y=49%, barrel body visibly extending diagonally back toward his arm near center. Face around x=55%, y=23%, cleanly separated above the weapon. Weapon must not be hidden on the left edge. The outer 18% at each side WILL be covered by card statistics, so keep head, gun body, muzzle and useful muzzle flash INSIDE x=23%-77%. Bright compact directional gold muzzle flash, tiny sparks and two or three ejected brass cartridges imply gunfire. Flash must not swallow the whole gun, face or scene. Physical gunfire, NOT a magic beam. One subtle recoil streak; crisp readable face, hands and gun.

SCENE AND LIGHT: recognizable interior of an industrial Mako reactor with a large distant cylindrical energy chamber emitting emerald-green light, vertical heavy conduits, overhead steel ribs and a catwalk rail. A small red warning lamp contrasts with green Mako light. Controlled background, simplified broad painted shapes behind the head, no crowded technical noise and no extra characters competing with Barret. The warm muzzle flash lights one side of his furious face, cool emerald spill models the other side. Emotionally charged, immediate, courageous, a dangerous action moment. No visible injury, blood, gore or fallen bodies.

ART DIRECTION: Kalistar's narrative fantasy PAINTING as in both references, confident visible brush strokes and sculpted color planes, expressive face, tactile weathered materials and selective edges. Not a film photograph, NOT CGI/3D, not glossy, not anime/manga. Highly polished painterly realism, same visual family as approved Aeris. No uniform noise, no smeared detail. Vertical 4:5 composition from knees up, character dominant, face large enough for a game card. Illustration ONLY, no card frame, border, statistics, text, logo, watermark or UI. Do not repaint the card itself.
